instruction:
On Google Public DNS, enter example.com and resolve it. On the results page, change RR Type to MX and resolve again. Report the complete result-configuration heading, Status number and mnemonic, TC, RD, RA, AD, and CD flags, the Question name and numeric/mnemonic type, and the name, numeric/mnemonic type, and data of every type-15 MX Answer record.

Stopping condition: Stop after the MX result heading, status, five flags, question, and every type-15 MX answer have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Perform the lookup through the supplied Google Public DNS form.
- Use the MX result, not the initial default A result.
- Do not report TTL because it changes with DNS cache age.
- Do not report or treat any RRSIG record as an MX answer if DNSSEC detail is shown.
